Net Asset Value | Company Announcement | Investegate Fundraise Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive UK Short Positions Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Net Asset Value PXN Growth VCT PLC 22 July 2026 PXN Growth VCT plc LEI Code 9845004ZDC57AB064B97 July 2026 We are delighted to report that on the 20 July 2026, all conditions having been satisfied, PXN Growth VCT plc (the " Company ") completed the sale of its holding in Street Group Limited to Hg Capital. The sale generated a 4.4 times return on investment for the Company. The transaction generated an uplift of 12.58 pence per share (12.86%) to the Company's unaudited NAV as at 30 April 2026. As a result, the effective unaudited NAV of the Company as at 20 th July 2026 is 110.39 pence per share. This revised unaudited NAV is only reflective of the Street Group Limited exit and does not reflect a revaluation of the entire wider portfolio. This announcement contains inside information for the purposes of Regulation 2014/596/EU (which forms part of domestic UK law pursuant to the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018) (" UK MAR "). Upon the publication of this announcement, this inside information (as defined in UK MAR) is now considered to be in the public domain. For any enquiries, please contact: Jon Prescott PXN Group Ltd Jon.Prescott@pxngroup.co.uk

The reported NAV is ex-dividend an interim dividend of 0.70 pence per Ordinary share payable in relation to the half year ended 31 March 2026 which will be paid on 31 July 2026 to those shareholders on the Company’s register on 26 June 2026. The unaudited cum-dividend NAV was 32.37 pence per Ordinary share.
